result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there is one major issue: a broken/placeholder image for Tokumaru Ramen Bar in the 'Popular right now' section, and a few minor issues such as truncated restaurant name and a partially cut-off category chip.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a broken/placeholder image icon on a gray background instead of the restaurant's photo
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loads correctly; add a fallback image or retry logic if the image fails to load

issues.description: Third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, which is expected but may hurt discoverability
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles or ensure truncation has ellipsis for clarity

issues.description: Last category chip is partially cut off at the right edge without an obvious scroll affordance
issues.suggestion: Add a partial peek of the next chip or a subtle fade/scroll indicator to signal horizontal scrolling

issues.description: The food images in 'Fastest near you' appear to be cartoonish placeholder illustrations rather than real restaurant photos
issues.suggestion: Replace placeholder illustrations with actual restaurant imagery once available
